question: What difference remains between dream and waking on this view?
premises: An objection asks what difference there would then be between dream and waking
The answer will be given later
Alternatively, for the free Lord nothing is impossible to express
inference: The apparent objection does not limit the free Lord, whose expression can encompass both dream and waking.
plain_english: If one asks what difference there would then be between dream and waking, that will be explained later; or else, what has not been spoken by the free Lord?
